name: ChartContainer
description: Standard chrome for charts: title, optional highlighted value, legend with toggle, range selector (radio cards), loading / empty states, and a footer for min/max/avg stats

props.name: title
props.description: Chart heading (renders as `<h3>` unless `header` is provided)

props.name: titleExtra
props.description: Optional node rendered immediately after the title text (e.g. an info tooltip). Only shown when `title` is set and `hea…
props.descriptionFull: Optional node rendered immediately after the title text (e.g. an info tooltip). Only shown when `title` is set and `header` is not. Additive - omit it and the title renders exactly as before

props.name: header
props.description: Replaces the default `title` heading with a custom element

props.name: headerAction
props.description: Optional action rendered on the right side of the header row (e.g. an expand/fullscreen toggle). Sits alongside the ran…
props.descriptionFull: Optional action rendered on the right side of the header row (e.g. an expand/fullscreen toggle). Sits alongside the range selector when both are present. Purely additive - omit it and the header renders exactly as before

props.name: legendData
props.description: Color-keyed legend items; each item can be toggled

props.name: highlightedValue
props.description: Large value/unit displayed alongside the legend

props.name: loader
props.description: Replaces the default `<Loader>` in the loading overlay

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Message shown when `empty` is true: a string, or any element (an `EmptyState`, say)

props.name: minMaxAvg
props.type: Partial<{ min: string; max: string; avg: string }>
props.description: Built-in footer showing Min / Avg / Max values

props.name: timeRange
props.description: Time range label shown in the footer

props.name: footer
props.description: Custom footer content rendered below the chart

props.name: footerClassName
props.description: Additional class for the footer area

props.name: className
props.description: Additional class for the root element

props.name: onToggleDataset
props.description: Fired when a legend item is clicked

fields.name: hidden
fields.description: Whether this dataset is currently hidden

fields.name: onChange
fields.description: Fires when user picks a range

fields.name: buttonClassName
fields.description: Additional class for each option button
